function: Uplink channel estimation for massive MIMO: a neural network predicts the correlation between measurement matrix and channel, giving sparsity-adaptive compressed-sensing recovery (p. 3-6).
system: BS with Nt=64 ULA, U=16 single-antenna users, indoor, uplink orthogonal pilots, no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 3, p. 7 Table III).
method: Fully connected network, five hidden layers (500,500,500,500,250), batch norm, ReLU; supervised offline training with RMSprop and MSE loss, online prediction (p. 5-6).
data_channel: Synthetic massive MIMO channel vectors drawn at random from a Rayleigh-based model; 10,000 samples, 8,000 training and 2,000 validation (p. 5-6).
test_conditions: Same Rayleigh model, Nt=64, U=16 for training and testing; sweeps over SNR 0-25 dB and pilot time slots K=5-10; independent test set (p. 6-9).
baselines: Learned DLCS (J=14) in NMSE results (p. 8-9); MMSE, LISTA, LAMP only in the complexity table (p. 7); compressed-sensing FPGA designs in Table VII (p. 13).
metrics: NMSE vs SNR and vs pilot slots; training MSE and cost; FPGA LUT, FF, DSP, BRAM use and reconstruction time (p. 8-13).
complexity: Sa-DLCS O(Nt^2) versus MMSE O(Nt^3), LISTA O(TM^2), LAMP O(2TNM) (Table II, p. 7); FPGA 12.4 us reconstruction, 175K LUT, 1.5K DSP (p. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 5: "channel model, which is based on the Rayleigh" distribution, a channel vector is created at random; custom simulator, no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 7: "with Nt = 64 antennas and U = 16" is the only scenario; results sweep SNR 0-25 dB (p. 8) and pilot slots K=5-10 (p. 9), with no statement that the network was trained under one condition and tested under another.
q3_support: p. 7: "comparison, the performance of the existing DLCS channel" estimation method is also considered; DLCS is learned, and MMSE, LISTA and LAMP appear only in the complexity Table II, so no non-learned baseline on NMSE.
q4_support: p. 7: "Therefore, the complexity of postprocessing is" O(Nt^2) and the whole method O(Nt^2), versus MMSE O(Nt^3) (Table II); p. 13 Table VII gives 12.4 us reconstruction time on FPGA.
q5_support: p. 5: "The massive MIMO channel environment is used to produce" the dataset; self-generated Rayleigh data, no code or data link, no public or measured dataset anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included as area 2 (channel estimation): DNN-assisted compressed sensing for uplink massive MIMO plus an FPGA design. DLCS (J=14) is the only NMSE baseline. Table VII compares FPGA reconstruction time with CS hardware designs, not estimation error. Frequency band not stated. The pilot-slot sweep (p. 9) is not described as training at one K and testing at another, so q2 is 0.
